documentationFacts.fact: Windows PowerShell5.1/powershell.exe is the declared floor. Supported PowerShell7/pwsh.exe is a separate host; the retained qualification is7.6.6. irm|iex executes downloaded response text in the chosen host.

Use Invoke-WebRequest -OutFile for exact pinned file, Get-Content -LiteralPath for review and a quoted -File path for the selected host. Never claim an explicit UTF8 string parse substitutes for native ParseFile on distributed bytes. Do not silently rewrite bytes/encoding or execution policy.
Manual extension installation/import/dashboard replacement and configured preset remain explicit. -DryRun preview is not staging/installation. No builder invocation change is needed.
